modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Carry-ons must fit in the overhead compartment or under the seat in front of you.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Carry-on size limit: H 22 in x W 14 in x L 9 in. Oversized carry-ons are checked at the gate for a fee.

weight_international.value: International flights: one cabin bag and one personal item per passenger; the cabin bag may weigh up to 5kg on itineraries with connecting flights and 10kg on direct flights. It is included at no extra fee.

domestic_rule.value: Domestic flights: only personal items are allowed in the cabin; carry-on bags are collected at boarding and stowed in the hold without charge.

cuba.value: Cuba: 1 carry-on up to 5kg and 1 personal item; an additional carry-on up to 5kg can be bought for $80 USD.

personal_item.value: A personal item (purse, laptop bag, backpack or camera case) must fit under the seat; the page gives its maximum size as normally 22cm x 25cm x 43cm (9in x 10in x 17in).

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Some Sunrise fares include a free checked bag; others pay per bag, cheaper online than at the call centre or airport.

size_weight.value: Max 62 inches (length + width + height). Weight limit per piece: 15kg on domestic flights and 23kg on international flights; 23kg is also allowed between Cap-Haïtien and Port-au-Prince.

fees_haiti_domestic.value: Domestic Haiti: Sun Promo K / Sun Plus V pay $40 online ($50 call center/airport) for the 1st bag; Sun Max N / Sun Risa B / Sun Flex Y get the 1st bag free. 2nd bag $75 online ($85 call center/airport).

fees_international_haiti.value: International to and from Haiti: Sun Promo K / Sun Plus V pay $65 online ($75 call center/airport) for the 1st bag; Sun Max N / Sun Risa B / Sun Flex Y get it free. 2nd bag $105 online ($115 call center/airport).

fees_eastern_caribbean.value: Eastern Caribbean: Sun Promo K / Sun Plus V pay $30 online ($40 call center/airport) for the 1st bag; Sun Max N / Sun Risa B / Sun Flex Y get it free. 2nd bag $50 online ($60 call center/airport).

cuba.value: All fares to Cuba include 30kg of checked baggage in 2 pieces; each piece over 23kg costs a $100 overweight fee.

overweight.value: Overweight fee (all fares): $40 for the 1st bag, $65 for the 2nd, $115 for the 3rd - 4th. Baggage fees are non-refundable unless the booking is cancelled within 24 hours of purchase or the bag is damaged or delayed.

phone_home_market.notes: Sunrise Airways official customer support line.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference
